question: What mitigations does ATT&CK list for T1055 (Process Injection)?

answer.headline: Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
answer.narrative: The MITRE ATT&CK technique Process Injection (T1055) lists two mitigations. These are Behavior Prevention on Endpoint (M1040) and Privileged Account Management (M1026).

claims.text: Found 2 item(s) related to T1055 (e.g. M1040, M1026) in MITRE ATT&CK.

task.text: What mitigations does ATT&CK list for technique T1055?

results.sub_question: What mitigations does ATT&CK list for technique T1055?
results.query: MATCH (t:Technique) WHERE t.attack_id IN $ids OPTIONAL MATCH (t)<-[:MITIGATES]-(m:Mitigation) RETURN t.attack_id AS technique_id, t.name AS technique_name, m.attack_id AS mitigation_id, m.name AS mitigation_name LIMIT 300
